name: token-bar-statusline
description: One-line usage statusline for ZCode: appends real session stats (turns, steps, tok/s, tokens, cache hit, context %) to the end of every reply, read from the local usage database.

description_i18n.en: Usage statusline: every reply ends with one real stats line — turns, steps, tok/s, session tokens, cache-hit rate and context % — read-only from the ZCode usage database.
description_i18n.zh-CN: ZCode 用量状态栏：每条回复末尾附一行真实用量（轮数、步数、tok/s、token 总量、缓存命中率、上下文占比），只读查询本地 usage 数据库。
